context: Deliberately failing pull request, used to verify that the repository ruleset blocks a merge when Security checks is red. Synthetic configuration error, no live target and no credentials involved.

log_evidence.collector_verdict: Security checks/2_Require all tests and scanners to have succeeded.txt: TEST_RESULT: success, SCAN_RESULT: failure, exit 1

ui_verification: Merge blocked in the GitHub pull request UI although the author holds admin rights and the ruleset grants no bypass. Confirmed manually; no screenshot is committed to this repository.
limitations: The REST field mergeable_state reported "unstable" rather than "blocked". That field predates rulesets; the UI is authoritative.
Verified is a pattern that removes every target file. An exclude that only reduces coverage stays unnoticed as long as at least one file is scanned.
The log archive follows the repository log retention, the four report artifacts expire after 30 days.
Unit tests and load_lock() accepted the sabotaged lockfile; only the real report exposed it.
